slides.texte_overlay:
rules i follow so i never
run out of things to say

ask about the story

i never ask what someone does, i ask how they ended up doing it. a job is a fact, but the path to it is a story, and people love telling the story of their lives.

follow the energy

when someone's voice changes on a topic, i stay on that topic. people light up about one or two things, and finding them makes every conversation easy from then on.

share something small

i share one small, honest thing about myself early on. it invites the other person to do the same, and the conversation stops feeling like an interview.

always have a fact

i learn one surprising fact every day in 5 minutes: about octopuses, ancient rome, the moon. one good fact is enough to restart any conversation that starts dying.

comfortable silence

i let short silences happen without panicking. a pause gives both people time to think, and the next thing said is usually more interesting than the last thing was.
